decisions.decision: Manual Knowledge Signal Cycle outputs must be committed only to a unique run-specific branch and submitted as a draft PR; no direct main push, force-push or auto-merge.
decisions.reason: Preserves generated knowledge while keeping main changes reviewable and approval-controlled.

decisions.decision: Run compileall and focused workflow-safety tests before creating/pushing the branch; upload generated outputs as a bounded artifact.
decisions.reason: GITHUB_TOKEN-created PR checks may not automatically run; pre-publication tests provide evidence in the originating workflow run.

decisions.decision: Treat PR #1379 as a verified proposal only; do not describe the main-branch write paths as fixed until approval and merge are observed.
decisions.reason: The exact-head tests and gate pass, but main is unchanged and the PR remains draft/unmerged.
